scope: Local experimental verification only; no report, GitHub upload, new issue or withdrawal.
conceptual_provenance: Extends arithmetic_v10; see runs/v10-sources.json. Sequential arithmetic repair and cross-candidate evidence were discussed in the previously consulted Lyan9145 README. Implementation here is independent; no third-party weights, code files or predictions copied.
change: Propagate earlier explicitly inconsistent numeric results into later numeric expressions; treat conflicting replacements as ambiguous; pool repair evidence and cross-candidate support by numeric answer group.
selection: Three train-question folds refit the base pairwise ranker, feature scalers and correction. CV chooses variant, regularization and strength. Validation retention threshold was declared in train_v11.py before test scoring. Frozen model evaluated once on test.
limitations: A repaired number can have a different semantic role later; features are probabilistic evidence rather than a proof. Earlier aggregate test scores are known; no claim of an untouched independent test. No per-question test errors were inspected.
ai_assistance: Substantive OpenAI Codex assistance in design, implementation, testing and execution.
